description: Publication lineage between SEPARATE documents in this corpus (not versions of one document). Keys are newer publications; values are older publications covering the same subject. Used only to measure how often older publications are retrieved for questions labelled on newer ones. Added in Phase 4 as a separate file so questions.jsonl and corpus.json, and the Phase 3 hashes, are unchanged.

evidence.sp800-61r3: The SP 800-61r2 PDF states on page 1 that it was withdrawn on 2025-04-03 and superseded in its entirety by SP 800-61r3.
evidence.csf-2.0: CSF 2.0 (2024) is the later version of the Cybersecurity Framework; the CSF 1.1 PDF (2018) carries no withdrawal notice.
